# Raasta

> Raasta is the intelligent travel app for India, a curated library of trips and multi-stop journeys, each fully researched with real budgets, best seasons and routes. It is currently pre-launch (coming soon to iOS and Android); visitors can join the waitlist at https://raasta.app.

## About
- What it is: A trip-intelligence app for India that scores destinations and journeys on weather, budget, reach time and fit, never on popularity or ad spend.
- What it gives travellers: Real all-in budgets, best time to go, multi-stop routes mapped stop by stop, packing and safety notes, and day-by-day plans.
- Status: Pre-launch landing page with a waitlist. It does not yet offer bookings, payments, user accounts, or live location tracking.
- Coverage: Destinations across every Indian state and union territory, from Himalayan passes to southern coasts.
- Company: Raasta, a pre-incorporation startup based in Delhi, India.
- Contact: hello@raasta.app
- Social: Instagram https://www.instagram.com/raasta.app · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/raasta-app-6367b2411/

## FAQ
- What is Raasta? An upcoming travel app for India that turns scattered trip research into clear answers: curated trips and multi-stop journeys with real budgets, the best time to go, routes and what to watch for.
- When will Raasta launch? It is in pre-launch, building toward an iOS and Android release. No fixed date yet; the waitlist is notified at launch.
- How much will Raasta cost? Pricing is not finalised. Joining the waitlist is free.
- What do I get by joining the waitlist? Launch and early-access updates by email, used only for Raasta updates (no spam).
- Does Raasta book hotels or transport? No. It is a trip-intelligence app for deciding where, when and how to travel; it does not currently offer bookings, payments or accounts.
- How is personal data handled? Only name, email and how you heard about Raasta are collected to manage the waitlist. See the Privacy Policy.
